section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the evolution of body image research towards positive body image, particularly body appreciation. It highlights the distinct nature of positive body image predictors compared to negative body image. The section outlines the aim of the present study, which is to integrate body appreciation into models of body image and eating behavior, examining interpersonal and intrapersonal variables as predictors and body appreciation as a mediator for outcomes like depressive symptoms and intuitive eating. The study draws upon insights from previous qualitative research by Wood-Barcalow et al. (2010) and Frisén and Holmqvist (2010) to inform its model variables.
